title: SenseTime’s Galaxy Project targets domestic AI chip scale-up
summary: SenseTime launched the Galaxy Project, partnering with nearly 20 companies to scale domestic AI chip infrastructure in China. Co-founder Yang Fan presented the initiative as a closed-loop ecosystem connecting chip-level technology with broader infrastructure development under the theme 'Intelligent Transformation and Symbiosis'.
problem_solved: China's strategic need to build self-sufficient domestic AI chip infrastructure amid technological restrictions.
why_valuable: It establishes a collaborative ecosystem approach to accelerate China's independent AI chip development and reduce reliance on foreign semiconductor technology.
